passages.text: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
passages.sermon:
Jesse was the father of King David.
A shoot will come from the stump of Jesse.
A branch will grow from Jesse’s roots.
This branch will bear fruit.
passages.original: וְיָצָ֥א חֹ֖טֶר מִגֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְנֵ֖צֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁ֥יו יִפְרֶֽה׃

passages.text: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him— the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A man will come from the family of Jesse.
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on this man.
The Spirit will give him wisdom.
The Spirit will give him understanding.
The Spirit will give him counsel.
The Spirit will give him strength.
The Spirit will give him knowledge.
The Spirit will give him fear of the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה ר֧וּחַ חָכְמָ֣ה וּבִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And He will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what His eyes see, and He will not decide by what His ears hear, but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
passages.sermon:
The promised ruler from Jesse’s line will delight in the fear of the LORD.
He will not judge by what His eyes see.
He will not decide by what His ears hear.
He will judge the poor with righteousness.
He will decide with fairness for the lowly of the earth.
He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth.
He will slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
passages.original: וַהֲרִיח֖וֹ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ לְמַרְאֵ֤ה עֵינָיו֙ יִשְׁפּ֔וֹט וְלֹֽא־ לְמִשְׁמַ֥ע אָזְנָ֖יו יוֹכִֽיחַ׃ וְשָׁפַ֤ט בְּצֶ֙דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר לְעַנְוֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו וּבְר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖יו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע׃

passages.text: Righteousness will be the belt around His hips, and faithfulness the sash around His waist.
passages.sermon: This passage describes the Messiah.\r\nThe Messiah will have righteousness as a belt around His hips.\r\nThe Messiah will have faithfulness as a sash around His waist.
passages.original: וְהָ֥יָה צֶ֖דֶק אֵז֣וֹר מָתְנָ֑יו וְהָאֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵז֥וֹר חֲלָצָֽיו׃

passages.text: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them.
passages.sermon:
The wolf will live with the lamb.
The leopard will lie down with the goat.
The calf, the young lion, and the fattened animal will be together.
A little child will lead them.
passages.original: וְגָ֤ר זְאֵב֙ עִם־ כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְנָמֵ֖ר עִם־ גְּדִ֣י יִרְבָּ֑ץ וְעֵ֨גֶל וּכְפִ֤יר וּמְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְנַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽם׃

passages.text: The cow will graze with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
passages.sermon: A cow will graze with a bear.\r\nTheir young will lie down together.\r\nA lion will eat straw like an ox.
passages.original: וּפָרָ֤ה וָדֹב֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה יַחְדָּ֖ו יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן וְאַרְיֵ֖ה כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹֽאכַל־ תֶּֽבֶן׃

passages.text: The infant will play by the cobra’s den, and the toddler will reach into the viper’s nest.
passages.sermon:
An infant will play near a cobra’s den.
A young child will put his hand into a viper’s nest.
The infant and the young child will not be harmed.
God will make the world safe and peaceful.
Even dangerous animals will not hurt children.
passages.original: וְשִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע יוֹנֵ֖ק עַל־ חֻ֣ר פָּ֑תֶן וְעַל֙ מְאוּרַ֣ת צִפְעוֹנִ֔י גָּמ֖וּל יָד֥וֹ הָדָֽה׃

passages.text: They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the sea is full of water.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His holy mountain.
No one will harm there.
No one will destroy there.
This will happen everywhere on God's holy mountain.
The earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD.
This knowledge will cover the earth like water covers the sea.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכָל־ הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃פ

passages.text: On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.
passages.sermon:
The Root of Jesse will appear on that day.
The Root of Jesse is a descendant of Jesse.
Jesse was the father of King David.
The Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for all peoples.
All nations will look to Him.
They will seek Him.
His place of rest will be glorious.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ יִשַׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹמֵד֙ לְנֵ֣ס עַמִּ֔ים אֵלָ֖יו גּוֹיִ֣ם יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה מְנֻחָת֖וֹ כָּבֽוֹד׃פ

passages.text: On that day the Lord will extend His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is the God of Israel.
The Lord will act on a special day.
On that day, the Lord will reach out His hand again.
He will do this for a second time.
The Lord will bring back the remnant of His people.
These people remain scattered in many lands.
Some are in Assyria.
Some are in Egypt.
Some are in Pathros.
Some are in Cush.
Some are in Elam.
Some are in Shinar.
Some are in Hamath.
Some are on the islands of the sea.
The Lord will gather all these people.
He will recover His people from every place.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ שֵׁנִית֙ יָד֔וֹ לִקְנ֖וֹת אֶת־ שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁאֵר֩ מֵאַשּׁ֨וּר וּמִמִּצְרַ֜יִם וּמִפַּתְר֣וֹס וּמִכּ֗וּשׁ וּמֵעֵילָ֤ם וּמִשִּׁנְעָר֙ וּמֵ֣חֲמָ֔ת וּמֵאִיֵּ֖י הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; He will collect the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The Lord will act on that day.
He will raise a banner for the nations.
He will gather the exiles of Israel.
He will collect the scattered people of Judah.
He will bring them from the four corners of the earth.
passages.original: וְנָשָׂ֥א נֵס֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאָסַ֖ף נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְפֻצ֤וֹת יְהוּדָה֙ יְקַבֵּ֔ץ מֵאַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then the jealousy of Ephraim will depart, and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will no longer envy Judah, nor will Judah harass Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
God will act on that day.
God will remove jealousy from Ephraim.
God will cut off the adversaries of Judah.
Ephraim will not envy Judah.
Judah will not harass Ephraim.
passages.original: וְסָ֙רָה֙ קִנְאַ֣ת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצֹרְרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹֽא־ יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה לֹֽא־ יָצֹ֥ר אֶת־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. They will lay their hands on Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.
passages.sermon:
God will gather His people from all nations.
They will move against the Philistines to the west.
They will attack together.
They will plunder the people of the east.
They will take control of Edom.
They will take control of Moab.
The people of Ammon will obey them.
passages.original: וְעָפ֨וּ בְכָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם אֱד֤וֹם וּמוֹאָב֙ מִשְׁל֣וֹח יָדָ֔ם וּבְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD will devote to destruction the gulf of the Sea of Egypt; with a scorching wind He will sweep His hand over the Euphrates. He will split it into seven streams for men to cross with dry sandals.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt.
The LORD will raise His hand over the Euphrates River.
The LORD will use His strong and scorching wind.
The LORD will strike the river.
The river will split into seven streams.
People will cross the river with dry sandals.
passages.original: וְהֶחֱרִ֣ים יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֚ת לְשׁ֣וֹן יָם־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ עַל־ הַנָּהָ֖ר בַּעְיָ֣ם רוּח֑וֹ וְהִכָּ֙הוּ֙ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה נְחָלִ֔ים וְהִדְרִ֖יךְ בַּנְּעָלִֽים׃

passages.text: There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God will make a highway.
This highway is for the remnant of His people.
These people remain after coming out of Assyria.
God did this before for Israel.
He made a way for Israel when they came up from Egypt.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה מְסִלָּ֔ה לִשְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׁאֵ֖ר מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָֽיְתָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּי֥וֹם עֲלֹת֖וֹ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
